cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: Initial Account Inquiry screen renders with header, filter prompt and column headings
cases.precondition: F-STD; the operator selects Account Inquiry from the authenticated Main Menu (Tran ORAI).
cases.steps:
1. Open the Account Inquiry function (Tran ORAI) from the Main Menu
2. Observe the initial screen before typing anything
cases.expected: The screen shows the header — Tran ORAI, Pgm OCACTIN, title 「ORION CREDIT CARD MANAGEMENT SYSTEM」, current Date and Time; the 「Filter:」 prompt with the cursor in the Filter field; the six result column headings 「Acct ID」 「St」 「Balance」 「Credit Lim」 「Available」 「Util%」; the totals line labels 「Page:」 「Matched:」 「PortBal:」 「PortAvl:」; and the message 「Type a filter and press ENTER.」
cases.remark: UI §2.1 map MACTINA (mapset MACTIN); 1000-SEND-INITIAL (WS-M-PROMPT L168), 8000-POPULATE-HEADER; SEND MAP L177

cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: Filter-type legend and function-key legend line are displayed verbatim
cases.precondition: F-STD; the initial Account Inquiry screen is shown.
cases.steps:
1. Read the two legend caption lines below the Filter field
2. Read the bottom line of the screen
cases.expected: The filter-type legend is shown on two lines 「ALL DELINQUENT OVER-LIMIT DORMANT」 and 「CLOSED NEW HIGH-UTIL」; the bottom line shows the key legend 「ENTER=Apply  PF7=Top  PF8=Fwd  PF3=Menu」.
cases.remark: UI §2.1 items 13,14 (legend captions) + item 108 (key legend line 24)

cases.mid: 初期値・デフォルト (Initial values / defaults)
cases.name: On open the filter defaults to ALL and totals start at zero
cases.precondition: F-STD; the Account Inquiry screen has just opened.
cases.steps: 1. Observe the filter description, page number, totals and cursor on the initial screen
cases.expected: The filter description shows 「ALL」; Page shows 0; Matched, PortBal and PortAvl are zero/blank; no account rows are listed; the cursor rests in the Filter field.

cases.mid: 初期値・デフォルト (Initial values / defaults)
cases.name: Pressing ENTER with an empty Filter runs the ALL filter
cases.precondition: F-STD; the Account Inquiry screen is open.
cases.steps:
1. Leave the Filter field empty
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: All 7 accounts are listed (Matched 7 under F-STD) and the filter description shows 「ALL」 — a blank filter is treated as ALL.

cases.mid: 表示条件・活性制御 (Display conditions / enable control)
cases.name: Filter is the only enterable field; result and total fields are display-only
cases.precondition: F-STD; the Account Inquiry screen is open.
cases.steps:
1. On the initial screen, tab across the fields
2. Apply the ALL filter and tab across the result screen
cases.expected: Only the Filter field accepts entry on the key prompt; every header, result-row and totals field is display-only, both before and after a search.
cases.remark: UI §2.1 item-states: FILT ○ on prompt / □ on result; all others □ both states

cases.mid: 表示条件・活性制御 (Display conditions / enable control)
cases.name: Unused result-row slots are cleared when fewer than 13 accounts match
cases.precondition: F-STD; the Account Inquiry screen is open.
cases.steps:
1. Type DELINQUENT (1 match under F-STD)
2. Press ENTER
3. Observe result rows 2 through 13
cases.expected: Row 1 shows the single matching account (10000000002); rows 2 through 13 are blank.

cases.mid: 文字・書式表示 (Characters / format display)
cases.name: Money, utilisation and counter fields are shown with their edit formats
cases.precondition: F-STD; the Account Inquiry screen is open.
cases.steps:
1. Apply the ALL filter
2. Inspect account 10000000007's row and the totals line
cases.expected: Balance, Credit Lim and Available show thousands separators, sign and two decimals (account 10000000007 → Balance 4,500.00, Credit Lim 5,000.00, Available 500.00); Util% shows 90.00; Page shows 1; Matched shows 7.
cases.remark: WS-ED-TOT '-,---,---,---,--9.99' sliced (2:15); WS-ED-UTIL ZZ9.99; WS-ED-PG ZZ9; WS-ED-RUN Z(6)9

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: Lower-case filter text is accepted (case-insensitive)
cases.precondition: F-STD; the Account Inquiry screen is open.
cases.steps:
1. Type the filter word in lower case
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The lower-case entry is treated the same as upper case; the delinquent filter runs and the description shows 「DELINQUENT」 (Matched 1 under F-STD).

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: A three-letter abbreviation selects the filter
cases.precondition: F-STD; the Account Inquiry screen is open.
cases.steps:
1. Type only the first three letters of a filter
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The over-limit filter runs — only the first three characters are matched — and lists 1 account under F-STD (account 10000000003, balance above its limit).

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: Unrecognised filter text is rejected with a message
cases.precondition: F-STD; the Account Inquiry screen is open.
cases.steps:
1. Type text that is not a known filter word
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: No search runs; the message line shows 「Filter not recognised - see the list above.」 and the cursor returns to the Filter field.

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF3 returns to the Main Menu
cases.precondition: F-STD; the Account Inquiry screen is open.
cases.expected: Control passes to the Main Menu; the Account Inquiry screen is left.

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF12 also returns to the Main Menu
cases.precondition: F-STD; the Account Inquiry screen is open.
cases.expected: Control passes to the Main Menu, the same as PF3.

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF4 clears the entry and redisplays the initial screen
cases.precondition: F-STD; a filter has been applied and results are showing.
cases.expected: The screen returns to its initial state: filter description 「ALL」, no result rows, message 「Type a filter and press ENTER.」, cursor in the Filter field.

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: CLEAR clears the screen and redisplays the initial screen
cases.precondition: F-STD; the Account Inquiry screen is open.
cases.expected: The initial screen is redisplayed (filter 「ALL」, no rows, prompt 「Type a filter and press ENTER.」).

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF8 pages forward to the next page of results
cases.precondition: F-PAGE14 (14 accounts all matching ALL); the ALL filter is applied and page 1 (13 rows) is shown with 「13 shown - PF8=more PF7=top」.
cases.expected: Page 2 is shown with the 14th account (1 row); Page shows 2 and the message shows 「1 shown - end of selection」.

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF7 restarts the listing at the first page
cases.precondition: F-PAGE14; the ALL filter is applied and paged forward to page 2.
cases.expected: The listing restarts at page 1 (first 13 accounts); Page shows 1 and the message shows 「13 shown - PF8=more PF7=top」.

cases.mid: 状態遷移 (Screen / state transitions)
cases.name: Entering from the Main Menu shows the initial inquiry screen once
cases.precondition: F-STD; the operator is on the Main Menu.
cases.steps: 1. Select Account Inquiry on the Main Menu (control arrives with first-entry context)
cases.expected: The initial Account Inquiry screen is displayed once (filter 「ALL」, prompt 「Type a filter and press ENTER.」); the transaction then waits for the next key.

cases.mid: 状態遷移 (Screen / state transitions)
cases.name: Starting the transaction directly initialises a fresh session
cases.precondition: F-STD; the transaction ORAI is started directly (no communication area is passed).
cases.expected: A fresh session is initialised and the initial inquiry screen is displayed (filter 「ALL」, prompt shown).

cases.mid: 状態遷移 (Screen / state transitions)
cases.name: Filter and page number are retained across a pseudo-conversational turn
cases.precondition: F-PAGE14; the ALL filter is applied and page 1 is shown.
cases.steps:
1. Press PF8 to page forward
2. Observe the filter description and page number
cases.expected: The next page is shown with the SAME filter 「ALL」 and Page advanced to 2 — the filter and paging state carried over the transaction turn.
cases.remark: 9000-RETURN TRANSID('ORAI') COMMAREA; state saved to CA-WORK-AREA(1:60) L165/L532, restored 2000-PROCESS-INPUT L183

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: ALL filter lists every account with portfolio totals
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.steps:
1. Type ALL (or leave the Filter blank)
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: All 7 accounts are listed; Matched 7, PortBal 13,450.00, PortAvl 20,550.00; the message shows 「7 shown - end of selection」.

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: DELINQUENT filter lists accounts that underpaid the cycle minimum
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.expected: Only account 10000000002 is listed (balance 2,000.00 > 0 and the 5.00 paid this cycle is below the minimum due of 40.00 = 2% of balance); Matched 1.

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Over-limit filter lists accounts whose balance exceeds the credit limit
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.expected: Only account 10000000003 is listed (balance 6,000.00 above credit limit 5,000.00; Available shows -1,000.00); Matched 1.

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Dormant filter lists accounts with no cycle activity
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.expected: Only account 10000000004 is listed (cycle credit 0.00 and cycle debit 0.00); Matched 1.

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Closed filter lists accounts whose active status is not Y
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.expected: Only account 10000000005 is listed (active status is 「N」, not 「Y」); Matched 1.

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: New filter lists accounts opened within the last 90 days
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.expected: Only account 10000000006 is listed (opened 2026-09-01, on/after the cutoff of about 2026-06-30); Matched 1.
cases.remark: 'N'; 4560-TEST-NEW open date numeric AND WS-OPEN-INT>=WS-CUT-INT (today − 90) L319/L335

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: High-utilisation filter lists accounts at or above 80% utilisation
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.expected: Accounts 10000000003 (utilisation 120.00%) and 10000000007 (utilisation 90.00%) are listed; Matched 2.

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: Available credit is credit limit minus balance
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.steps:
1. Apply the ALL filter
2. Read the Available column for accounts 10000000007 and 10000000003
cases.expected: Available shows 500.00 for account 10000000007 (5,000.00 − 4,500.00) and a negative -1,000.00 for account 10000000003 (over limit).

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: Utilisation percentage is balance divided by limit times 100
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.steps:
1. Apply the ALL filter
2. Read the Util% column

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: Portfolio totals sum the whole matched set, not just the visible page
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.steps:
1. Apply the ALL filter
2. Read the Matched, PortBal and PortAvl totals
cases.expected: Matched 7; PortBal 13,450.00 (sum of all seven balances); PortAvl 20,550.00 (sum of all seven available amounts) — the totals span every matched account.

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: Delinquency minimum due uses a 25.00 floor for small balances
cases.precondition: F-STD plus account 10000000010 (active, balance 500.00, paid 20.00 this cycle, opened 2015-01-01).
cases.steps:
1. Type DELINQUENT
2. Press ENTER
3. Check whether account 10000000010 appears
cases.expected: Account 10000000010 IS listed: 2% of 500.00 is 10.00, but the 25.00 floor raises the minimum due to 25.00, and the 20.00 paid is below 25.00. (Without the floor, 20.00 ≥ 10.00 would have excluded it.)
cases.remark: OUACTIN WS-MIN-DUE=AC-CURR-BAL*0.02 rounded L250; IF bal>0 AND WS-MIN-DUE<WS-MIN-FLOOR(25.00) → 25.00 L251-252

cases.mid: データ整合性・冪等性 (Data integrity / idempotency)
cases.name: Portfolio totals are not recomputed when paging forward
cases.precondition: F-PAGE14; the ALL filter is applied and page 1 is shown (Matched 14 with PortBal/PortAvl computed).
cases.steps:
1. Press PF8 to view page 2
2. Compare the totals with page 1
cases.expected: Matched, PortBal and PortAvl on page 2 are identical to page 1 — page-forward reuses the totals computed at filter-apply and does not rescan the file.
cases.remark: 2300-PAGE-FWD SET KAI-SKIP-KPI L269; totals held in WS-ST-POP-* across the turn

cases.mid: データ整合性・冪等性 (Data integrity / idempotency)
cases.name: Re-applying a filter recomputes the totals; no account is changed
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.steps:
1. Apply DELINQUENT (Matched 1)
2. Apply ALL again
3. Check the totals and the account file
cases.expected: The totals recompute for each apply (Matched 1, then Matched 7); the inquiry only reads — no account row is created, changed or removed.
cases.remark: 2100-APPLY-FILTER SET KAI-DO-KPI on each apply L232; UI §5 CRUD none (read-only browse)

cases.mid: 連携・インターフェース (Linkage / interface)
cases.name: The screen requests a page from the account-browse engine and renders the reply
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.expected: The screen hands the request (filter code, start key, totals flag) to the account-browse engine and displays the page it returns — up to 13 rows plus the matched count, portfolio totals and the more/last-page message.
cases.remark: 3000-CALL-SUB LINK PROGRAM('OUACTIN') COMMAREA(KACTIN-AREA) L305; request KAI-FILTER/KAI-START-KEY/KAI-DO-KPI, reply KAI-ROW/KAI-ROW-COUNT/KAI-MORE-SW/KAI-NEXT-KEY

cases.mid: 連携・インターフェース (Linkage / interface)
cases.name: Returning to the menu hands over the shared communication area
cases.precondition: F-STD; results are showing.
cases.expected: Control passes to the Main Menu carrying the shared communication area, with the originating program and transaction recorded so the menu knows where the operator came from.
cases.remark: 7000-XCTL-MENU: CA-FROM-PROGRAM=WS-PGMNAME, CA-FROM-TRANID=WS-TRANID, CA-PGM-CONTEXT=0; XCTL OCMENU COMMAREA L517

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: An unsupported key is rejected with a message
cases.precondition: F-STD; the inquiry screen is showing results.
cases.expected: No action is taken; the message line shows 「Invalid key pressed. Please try again.」 and the current screen is redisplayed.

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: A filter that matches nothing reports no accounts
cases.precondition: F-NODLQ (the account file holds only healthy account 10000000001; no delinquent account exists).
cases.expected: No rows are listed; the message line shows 「No accounts match that filter.」; Matched 0.

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: Paging past the last page reports the end of selection
cases.precondition: F-STD; the ALL filter is applied (7 accounts on a single page, no more).
cases.expected: No further page is fetched; the message line shows 「End of selection - no more accounts.」.

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: Pressing PF7 before any listing prompts to apply a filter first
cases.precondition: F-STD; the initial screen is shown with no filter applied yet.
cases.expected: No listing runs; the message line shows 「Apply a filter first (press ENTER).」.

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: Pressing PF8 before any listing prompts to apply a filter first
cases.precondition: F-STD; the initial screen is shown with no filter applied yet.
cases.expected: No listing runs; the message line shows 「Apply a filter first (press ENTER).」 — the same guard as PF7, reached from a distinct trigger.

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: A failure reaching the browse engine is reported
cases.precondition: F-STD; the account-browse engine is unavailable (the LINK returns a response other than normal).
cases.expected: No results are shown; the message line shows 「Unable to reach the account browse engine.」.

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: A browse error returned by the engine is reported
cases.precondition: F-STD; the browse engine returns an error status (e.g. the account file cannot be read).
cases.expected: No results are shown; the message line shows 「Error browsing the account file.」.
cases.remark: 3000-CALL-SUB ELSE IF KAI-ERROR → WS-M-BROWSE-ERR L312-316; OUACTIN §5.2 file-response check

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Exactly 13 matches fill one page with no continuation
cases.precondition: F-PAGE13 (13 accounts all matching ALL).
cases.expected: All 13 accounts are shown on page 1; the more-flag is off and the message shows 「13 shown - end of selection」; pressing PF8 next would report the end of selection.

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: A 14th match spills to a second page
cases.precondition: F-PAGE14 (14 accounts all matching ALL).
cases.steps:
1. Type ALL and press ENTER (page 1)
2. Press PF8 (page 2)
cases.expected: Page 1 shows 13 rows with 「13 shown - PF8=more PF7=top」 (more-flag on); page 2 shows the 14th row with 「1 shown - end of selection」.
cases.remark: page1 KAI-ROW-COUNT=13 & WS-ST-MORE='Y'; page2 count 1, MORE='N'

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Filter needs three matching characters; two are not enough
cases.precondition: F-STD; the Account Inquiry screen is open.
cases.steps:
1. Type DEL and press ENTER
2. Reset, type DE and press ENTER
cases.expected: 「DEL」 (3 characters) is accepted and runs the delinquent filter; 「DE」 (only 2 characters) is not recognised and the message line shows 「Filter not recognised - see the list above.」.

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Utilisation is capped at 999.99
cases.precondition: F-STD plus account 10000000011 (active, balance 60,000.00, credit limit 500.00).
cases.steps:
1. Type HIGH
2. Press ENTER
3. Read account 10000000011's Util% and Available
cases.expected: Util% shows 999.99 (the raw 12,000% is capped); Available shows -59,500.00 (500.00 − 60,000.00).
cases.remark: OUACTIN IF WS-UTIL-BIG>999.99 → WS-UTILR=999.99 L242-243; KAI-R-UTIL 9(03)V99

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: New-account cutoff includes on/after the cutoff and excludes before it
cases.precondition: F-STD plus account 10000000012 (opened 2020-01-01) and account 10000000013 (open date blank / non-numeric).
cases.expected: Account 10000000006 (opened 2026-09-01, on/after the cutoff) is listed; account 10000000012 (opened 2020-01-01, before the cutoff) and account 10000000013 (open date not a valid number) are NOT listed.
cases.remark: 4560-TEST-NEW numeric guard on open date + WS-OPEN-INT>=WS-CUT-INT (today − 90)

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: High-utilisation threshold is inclusive at 80.00%
cases.expected: Account 10000000014 (utilisation exactly 80.00%) IS listed; account 10000000015 (79.99%) is NOT.

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Over-limit is strict: balance equal to the limit is not over
cases.precondition: F-STD plus account 10000000016 (balance 5,000.00, limit 5,000.00) and account 10000000017 (balance 5,000.01, limit 5,000.00).
cases.expected: Account 10000000017 (balance 5,000.01 above the limit) IS listed; account 10000000016 (balance 5,000.00 equal to the limit) is NOT.

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Delinquency is strict: paying exactly the minimum due is not delinquent
cases.precondition: F-STD plus account 10000000018 (balance 2,000.00, paid 40.00) and account 10000000019 (balance 2,000.00, paid 39.99); the minimum due is 2% of 2,000.00 = 40.00.
cases.expected: Account 10000000019 (paid 39.99, below 40.00) IS listed; account 10000000018 (paid 40.00, equal to the minimum due) is NOT.
